deck.title: Facilities Manager
deck.description: Broad facilities management interview deck applicable to recreation centres, arenas, and civic buildings.

cards.question: How do you balance preventive maintenance with reactive breakdowns in a busy recreation facility?
answerFramework: Describe PM program basics (HVAC, ice plant, pools, life safety)
How you protect PM when emergencies hit
Metrics you track (backlog, MTBF, energy, complaints)

star.situation: High-use arena or aquatics centre with aging assets.
star.action: PM calendar, condition assessments, contractor strategy, after-hours plan.
star.result: Fewer emergency shutdowns; predictable capital planning input.

cards.bestStory: Ice plant or pool system where PM investment avoided a costly mid-season failure.

whatGoodSoundsLike: Systems thinker who protects PM under pressure
Speaks to user experience and safety

cards.question: Tell us about a difficult performance conversation with a long-tenured staff member.
answerFramework: Specific behaviour gap tied to standards
Private, documented conversation with clear expectations

star.situation: Tenured operator resisting new procedure or slipping attendance/quality.
star.task: Address issue while preserving team trust.
star.action: Fact-based discussion, listened, agreed plan, HR consulted as needed.
star.result: Improved performance or dignified separation; team saw consistent standards.

cards.bestStory: Custodial or maintenance lead resistant to new chemical handling protocol—you turned it into training success.

whatGoodSoundsLike: Understands union and HR context where applicable

cards.question: A member of the public reports a strong chemical smell near the pool deck during peak hours. What do you do?
answerFramework: Immediate life safety actions (evacuate area if needed, notify aquatics lead)
Investigate source with qualified staff; don't guess
Communicate with front desk and management; document incident

star.situation: Busy Saturday swim; smell causes concern at deck and viewing area.
star.task: Protect patrons while minimizing panic and unnecessary full closure.
star.action: Isolate area, verify ventilation and chemical feed, test if qualified, brief management.
star.result: Safe resolution; clear patron communication; incident log and follow-up inspection.

cards.bestStory: Similar real event where you coordinated aquatics, maintenance, and front desk messaging calmly.
